His wings flexed with a pulse of golden-white light as his gaze swept the horizon.
Even Thauron had stopped laughing.
Altheon could feel something off.
He did not just sense an increase in complexity from that shockwave.
He felt Living Existential Authorities- plural- carried on that wave.
More than one.
Why...would there be Living Existential Authorities here as if Living Origins, Living Paradoxes, Living Elemental, and others having a party?!
Altheon clenched his hands slowly as he looked around.
Just What the hell was happening in these Folds?!

chapters.title: Chapter 3857: A True Festival! V
paragraphs: He had known these Folds to be dangerous and unique, yes.
The birthplace of a Living Paradox that defied all dogma. But now, they were resonating with Authority so potent that even Originus Venerants would flinch.
He would mention this to the Honored Living Origin He would elevate these Folds in classification. No longer curiosities. No longer whispers. But a Primary Concern.
They must be studied.
The secrets hidden within the Gravewake...they could not be allowed to breed another.
Another anomaly could not be allowed to rise even before they dealt with the first one!
As Altheon thought this...

"Well, well," Thauron’s voice rolled out like smoke, thick with mockery and the quiet hiss of something watching too closely. "It seems, my friend, that the pot has begun to boil over. I think that I would like my payment now. You see, I don’t like surprises, and the unknown has a particularly nasty flavor to it as something ridiculous seems to be happening in these Folds..."
Altheon’s gaze turned upon the creature, his eyes narrowing with distaste!
Back in the Infiniverse Wheel of Existence.
Hymns.
The echo of them carved the silent stellar space as they were followed by...
Prompts.
|The Infiniverse Wheel of Existence began and ended her transformation into an Early Living Transcendent Infiniverse Wheel of Existence in an instant.|
|All Weavings of the Wheel are transcending to fit the complexity of Living Folds of Existence.|

|The Infiniverse Wheel of Existence has denied the chance to transcend into any Transcendent Living Folds. At a time of its choosing, Transcendence into Transcendent Paradoxical Folds, Transcendent Origin Folds, Transcendent Elemental Folds, Transcendent Spiritual Folds...or any other Transcendent Living Folds.|
Noah read them without blinking, the depth behind his gaze never faltering. The air around him shimmered, light diffusing like a prism around his figure.
He had watched. He had waited. And now he witnessed.
He witnessed Ruination, and he was now witnessing the Infiniverse!
The transformation that many failed at- where countless Wheels cracked under the pressure of their own ideals...had occurred.
And it had succeeded.
It had taken others eons.
The Infiniverse had done it in a breath.
An instant!
And she had done it while denying Transcendence. Refusing to be told where she belonged. Choosing instead to decide for herself later on.
He breathed in slowly.
The Crucible was no longer a still pond.
It was a storm.
And the rest of the Folds were beginning to feel the tremors.
In the stillness that followed the echo of transformation, Noah stood amidst the symphony of the Festival of Existence, his presence calm beneath the glows of many Towers of Origin.

The very air around him vibrated with Living Existential Authority, the hymns of Mythic Living True Signatures overlapping in strange harmonies. It would have overwhelmed most. But for him, it was only the start.
Noah closed his eyes.
There was a soft pulse within the weavings of his existence- an ancient rhythm that beat in perfect synchrony with the one he had crafted so carefully, so intimately. The Infiniverse.
Through the connection between them, he could feel it: the Infiniverse’s transformation was only just getting started.
Instantaneous? Yes. Complete? No.
The True Frequencies, shaped like impossibly vast Spokes within the Infiniverse’s Wheel of Existence, were shifting. Not breaking. Not ending. But metamorphosing.
Continuity. Dreams. Relativity. Manadynamics. Genesis. Prana. Each of them, titanic structures of authority and power, turning and aligning under the momentum of something far greater.
His awareness dipped deeper.
And he saw her.
Not in the way he saw with eyes or even through Existential Sight, but through the connection that bound them.

She had bodies- no, expressions of herself, each one the size of constellations. Massive Mythic illusions of shimmering radiance stretching across domains wider than omniverses, these forms moved with grace and weight that made all of Existence feel small.
In one of these forms, she cradled the Spoke of Continuity like a Mythic Living True Signature holding up a tower!

Verdant and endlessly spiraling, the True Frequency of Continuity pulsed with rich, emerald hues, glowing like a dream recollected on the edge of sleep. And there she was, the Infiniverse, arms wrapped around it like it was sacred, like it was fragile, like it was hers. From her embrace, a Tower of Origin began to form, its bones spinning from the Frequency itself, beams of continuity laced in with the whispering of hymn and purpose.
A sacred construction.
A sacred birth!
And Noah knew this was not isolated.
She would do this again for every Spoke. Each one becoming the backbone for something newer, something grander.
His heart, ever still, ever controlled, trembled slightly.

Because this... this was merely the foundation. A springboard. He could feel that the winds were picking up, curling through the Crucible and wrapping around the many Towers of Origin like eager spirits.

They whispered to one another. They swirled through the seams of the Infiniverse, dragging in torrents of Living Origin Authority as if the Crucible itself had become a living organism- breathing, dreaming, pulsing.
His aura flowed freely across all of them as he continued to produce dull crimson-gray droplets of blood!
|The Transformation of the Infiniverse Wheel of Existence was and remains under the heavy influence of an Early Creature.|
The prompt whispered through the folds of reality like thunder dressed in silk.
|The inclusion and immersion of multiple Living Existential Authorities have paved the way for the Emergence of a shred of the musings of an Early Veiled Shore...|
HUUM!
His eyes opened in surprise.
Slowly.
Burning gold, ringed in black and luminous paradox.
Early Veiled Shore? What was this?
He looked across the Infiniverse Crucible, where spiraling clouds of authority danced across the horizon like celestial waves.
There, he focused on the Infiniverse Body.

Her skin shimmered with tones of all True Frequencies- a living aurora. Her hair was no longer merely strands but rivers of temporal and energetic continuity, coiling around her like serpents made of starlight. She was... not normal by any means. Not Origin. Not Paradox. Not just his. She had become something else.
And still, her hand stretched outward at this moment.
Not to him.
But to Ruination.

Ruination looked up, her golden-crimson wings folding gently behind her. There was something quintessential in her gaze, a residual ache of loss and reunion not quite settled. But the moment her sister reached out, she understood.
She floated forward, her hand sliding into the Infiniverse Body’s without hesitation.
They clasped.
And in that moment...resplendent crimson gold light bathed everything once more!
BOOM!
|The Living Origin, Ruination, has made a Declaration of Living Existential Proliferation targeting the emergence of the shred of the musings of an Early Veiled Shore.|

chapters.title: Chapter 3858: Early Veiled Shore I
paragraphs: The Crucible shuddered. The entirety of the Early Living Transcendent Infiniverse Wheel of Existence shuddered!
The prompt repeated again!
|The Living Origin, Ruination, has made a Declaration of Living Existential Proliferation targeting the emergence of the shred of the musings of an Early Veiled Shore.|
The Hymns paused, as if to make room for something older the moment that Ruination joined hands with the Infiniverse and enacted a Proliferation!!
|Shreds have accumulated.|
|Shreds have been multiplied.|
|Shreds have bloomed and turned into actualizations.|
The sky above them cracked with golden threads of forgotten purpose. Veins of Paradox, Origin, and more!

|Through the hands of the Living Origin, Ruination, the Early Transcendent Infiniverse Living Wheel of Existence, and your aura and distinction as an Early Creature, the most rudimentary and natal version of an Early Veiled Shore, a Budding Shore, shall bloom at the center of the Infiniverse.|
HUUM!
One explosive string of information after another came!
At the center of the Infiniverse Wheel of Existence, he felt the shift as something subtle and massive rooted itself- like the planting of a World Tree without trunk or seed.
Noah’s breath was steady. But his heart... his heart sang with quintessence.
He looked at his companions- Ruination glowing, clasping her sister’s hand, and the Infiniverse, floating gloriously, her gaze flicking toward him as if to say...
Witness us!
Because the two of them working together made way for the rapid emergence of something unfathomable!
At the center of the Infiniverse Wheel of Existence, where Spokes once merely represented Frequencies, now stood embryonic Towers covering them.
And from those rising bones of Existence, light- raw, unfiltered light of Continuity, of Dreams, of Genesis and Relativity and so much more- gathered toward the Wheel’s very heart.
It was not a gathering of stars.
It was not even a singularity in the traditional sense.
It was something... older.

Noah’s breath pulsed as he felt his Early Living Towers of Origin resonate. Their hymns bled out in reverent chorus, pouring endless torrents of Living Origin Authority toward that spiraling point at the Wheel’s center. The call was not forceful, but inevitable.
Drawn forward without resistance, Noah’s body vanished from the Crucible.
Ruination followed him with a pulse of crimson gold.
The Infiniverse Body glided like a comet streaking behind, multicolored rivers of existence dancing in her wake.
They left the Infiniverse Crucible!
Together, they arrived at the center of the Wheel of Existence!
Before it.
The singularity had bloomed the moment they appeared.
But it did not expand in a show of grandeur.
It compressed into something impossibly refined.
Only a thousand miles in diameter!
In a place where omniverses were considered rooms, where galaxies were mere verses in a longer song... this was small. Humble. Quiet.
And yet, the power emanating from it churned every fold of their being.
The air was thick with Living Existential Authority, but twisted through it all was mist.
White-gray fog, dense and slow-moving, forming lazy spirals around the new-formed land. There was no thunder. No cataclysm. Just this mist...and its scent. Primal. Ancient.
Foreign.
Even to him.
|The Budding Shore, an early stage of an Early Veiled Shore, has begun emerging.|
|It awaits for an Early Creature to step into it to unlock its full emergence and wonders.|
What would it mean?
What would a land belonging to beings like him truly offer?
What did the memory of home feel like for a race unknown and unheard of?
He floated forward.
The mist parted for him, not with resistance, but reverence. Every tendril of fog curled around him like it had known him once, long ago, and had been waiting patiently for his return.
He went past the impenetrable fog.
And then his feet met the sand.
Warm.
Unyielding.
Alive. Very much alive!
The moment he stepped foot upon the shore, it was as though time hiccuped, then rearranged itself to welcome him.
|You have unlocked an Early Veiled Shore.|
|A consecrated land where anyone stepping on it will become Living Existence (Randomized to the types of Living Existences currently bound to you).|
|Current Maximum Population Occupancy: 25.|
BOOM!
Noah didn’t move as he absorbed the shocking prompt!

He let the grainy softness of the golden sand shift beneath his boots. The wind here was gentle, not oppressive. It did not howl or shriek like the storms in many other Domains of power. It sang. Whistled. A quiet lullaby, carried by threads of primal magic embedded in the air and land alike.
He looked up.
The coastline curved gracefully, embraced by wide calm currents of water that shimmered crystalline blue.

The sea here did not stretch to the horizon. It ended abruptly at the mist’s edge- an outer rim of fog that bordered the entire Budding Shore. It was not water that claimed its boundaries, but ambiguity.
Beyond that fog? No one knew.

The land was untamed. Simple. No architecture. No cities. No structures left behind from ancient builders. Just untouched grasslands, the color of deep summer, and vibrant green vegetation sprouting in graceful waves across the interior.
At the very center, three trees stood. Just three.
Not tall.
Not wide.
But distinct.

Each one shimmered with strange resonance, their bark lined with faint glowing runes, their leaves tinted with shades that mimicked Living Origin Authority. They stood in a small clearing, rooted in soil that pulsed slightly underfoot as though the land itself breathed.

Noah felt the breath and air of this place that caused his Living Existential Authorities to churn and cycle faster than even the deepest concentration of authorities in the Transcendent Paradoxical Folds!
Denser authority than...even the Paradoxical Dyson Sphere!
He felt such dense authority rise to meet his own.
Behind him, Ruination touched the sand and gasped.
The Infiniverse floated beside her, pausing mid-step as her radiant toes brushed the coastline.

Noah moved forward, and as he walked, his gaze fell to the clear waters nearby. The coast sparkled with light that should not exist in such simplicity- pale blues, iridescent whites, faint golds all dancing beneath the tide like stardust fallen into the sea.
He knelt.
Touched the surface.
The water rippled away, serene and cool.

|You have observed the Early Sacred Water of the Budding Shore. Drinking it aids in rising one’s Purity, but one must not drink too quickly, else the Early Intoxication will slowly erase their sense of self and existence. One drop of the Early Sacred Water is enough to raise one’s Purity from nothing to Originus Venerant.|
Noah froze.
One drop.
A single drop, and a normal human could attain the purity of an Originus Venerant entity!
And the cost if one drank too much...was the loss of self. The fraying of who you are in pursuit of what you might become.
His fingers remained dry even while playing with these waters.

He turned his back to the sea and faced the heart of the Budding Shore. The trees. The soil. The mist. A sanctuary born not just from authority or power, but from a convergence of far too many quintessential possibilities.
He felt the weight settle on his shoulders.
Responsibility.
Possibility.
Belonging.
The Budding Shore pulsed again.
And the mists thickened ever so slightly...as if something unseen within the fog had begun to stir!

chapters.title: Chapter 3859: Early Veiled Shore II
paragraphs: The mist curled gently against Noah’s feet as if the land itself exhaled through soft fog.
The sky above the Budding Shore was quiet and unfathomably peaceful in this primitive primal looking landscape!

He stood still for a long moment, his gaze fixed on the gently rippling waves of the Early Sacred Water. The clarity of it was unreal. It shimmered with hues of pale sapphire and translucent silver, each ripple reflecting back not just light or beauty, but waves of immeasurable existence.
His eyes narrowed.
He reached out with his will.

A thin hum of his authority pulsed forth- Living Existential Authority wrapped in the frequencies of Wrath, of Paradox, and of Infinity itself. Normally, this would be more than enough to reshape swatches of existence.
And yet...
BZZT!
The water didn’t budge.
A single line of white text bloomed in the air before him.
|The Early Sacred Water of the Budding Shore cannot be altered or influenced by authority, with actions needing to be taken manually.|
His brows lifted.

Even with everything he had become, after everything he had shattered and remade, this place still demanded simplicity. He let out a soft breath, and for the first time in a while, he smiled. It was a quiet smile. A recognition of the absurdity and... humility, in this.

Behind him, a soft rustle stirred the sand near the shore. The Infiniverse Body knelt beside him. Her features glowed with a luminous silver hue, her hair flowing like multicolored rivers of molten existence.
She didn’t speak initially as she just stared at the radiant waters with him.
Then, softly....
"Throughout this whole Early Veiled Shore, authority does not seem to affect it much. Not its water... sands... or anything else."
Her voice was calm and almost reverent. But beneath it, a note of surprise lingered. Of understanding dawning in silence.
"This place," she said, more to herself now, "even though it bloomed within me and sits at the centee of the Wheel... it feels like something immensely isolated. Deeply connected to you."
Noah said nothing for a heartbeat. Then, slowly, he nodded.
He dipped his hands into the water, cool and bright, cupping it until it filled his palms with a soft glow.
Since he could not use an authority to draw it, he would do it manually!
And so, he raised his hands up and drank.
And...
HUUM!

It was not just a taste, it was immersion! The moment the water touched his lips, a current of fire and frost alike flowed down his throat. It passed through him as if seeping into his very weavings of existence as his very Lineage hummed.
He gasped softly.
|You have consumed 100 Units of the Early Sacred Water. Your Early Living Towers of Origin drink up its nourishment of extreme purity and expand in their growth rapidly.|
His eyes fluttered shut as he felt it.
A bloom. No, a surge!

His purity rose like a sun breaking over a frozen horizon, sharp and blinding. The complexity within his Towers surged madly, Lattices shifting like living constellations, growing in density and strength!
"This is..." he whispered, his voice trailing in disbelief. "Mad."
It was more than what the Paradoxical Dyson Singularity had granted. That had been dense with Living Paradoxical Authority, layered and strange...but this?
This was clean. Sharp. Pure.
And the water was just the beginning.
Another prompt rose before his eyes, clean and white against the misty air.

|Having consumed the Early Sacred Water, you have gained the knowledge that within the shore, Early Living Marine Lifeforms occasionally appear. If you are capable of catching one, their nourishment can range from 100x to 1,000,000x more potent than the nourishment of the Sacred Water itself. Early Creatures used to fish in Early Veiled Shores to build up their purity and complexity.|
|As a Budding Shore, the frequency and rarity of Early Living Marine Lifeforms appearing is low.|
Another ridiculous set of prompts bloomed m!

Fish that could make this water seem like child’s play as it stated...if one was capable of catching one!
Just by stepping into this land, one became a Living Existence as they would have Originus Venerant level power just from drinking its Sacred Water.
And even such beings...may not be capable of catching the fish in these waters?
It made Noah curious of what would come out!
A deep hum of amusement stirred in his chest. Because he knew what he’d become. He knew what he was now capable of.
He closed his eyes once more, and with a single thought, brought forth his own internal status panel that changed ever so often.

He felt mighty!

The wonder of having multiple True Sources would only show itself more and more over time as while other Originus Venerant entities had a million or a few million Existential Dimensional Lattices, he had over 100 million and counting, and he would spill over 150 Million soon enough.
If he faced another common Originus Venerant entity...
If he were to meet Master Hannibal now... or even another Originus Venerant who lacked a Foldless identity...?
He would not just merely fight.
He would erase!
His fingers curled loosely at his side.
Not out of arrogance. Not out of pride.
But out of an ever-deepening understanding of what he was becoming.
The thought came unbidden, smooth as the mist.
He was once a man trying to understand Existence.
Now, he was the paradox threading its center!

The sky above the Budding Shore was quiet and unfathomably peaceful in this primitive primal looking landscape!
He stood still for a long moment, his gaze fixed on the gently rippling waves of the Early Sacred Water.
The clarity of it was unreal.
It shimmered with hues of pale sapphire and translucent silver, each ripple reflecting back not just light or beauty, but waves of immeasurable existence.
His eyes narrowed.
He reached out with his will.

BZZT!

chapters.title: Chapter 3860: Early Veiled Shore III
paragraphs: The light in this place was a dream- soft, golden, and persistent.
It threaded through the gently swirling mist and kissed the verdant shorelines with a tender gleam, casting shadows that danced slowly across the untouched sands.
"Master!"

Noah turned his head as Ruination called to him, her voice distant but clear, laced with excitement and awe. She stood near one of the three towering trees at the center of the Budding Shore, her arm gently extended toward its trunk.

He began to move toward her, each step sinking slightly into the soft, warm earth. The slight mist parted with grace as he approached the tree, its grandeur becoming more evident with every breath he took.
A single massive trunk of rich amber-brown wood spiraled upward, its bark covered in soft whorls that pulsed with a low, warm light.

The leaves were broad and sunlit gold, shimmering softly as if bathed in endless dusk. Each leaf was translucent at the edges, revealing tiny veins of glowing vitality that whispered with ancient breath of time.
A new prompt bloomed before his vision as he neared the tree.

|You have discovered the Heartwood Suntree of this Budding Shore. It will bear the Sunpetal Nectarine Wheel- a fruit in the form of a Unique Wheel of Existence that is capable of rapidly increasing the complexity of Early Lifeforms seeking to build their Towers of Origin. To allow the fruits to bloom and ripen faster, the Heartwood Suntree thrives on Early Sacred Water...|
Heartwood Suntree! Sunpetal Nectarine Wheels of Existence! Wheels of existence that one could...eat?
Just how uniquely had the Early Creatures lived that they were eating Wheels of Existence budding from Trees?
Noah became ever curious about the Story of the Earliest Folds, and what occured after THE Living Paradox was locked away while the Creature left with all other Living Existences.
Did Early Creatures bloom thereafter? Where were they now? Where was THE Creature himself that had given its Everything?
Many questions buzzed in his mind as it seemed like his other bodies with Moiraine and Sigrid would have to get more of this story soon.
Noah’s gaze lingered back on the golden leaves of the tree, each one fluttering with a rhythm that felt synchronized to the very beat of this Early Land.
Of course the trees would be just as extraordinary as the water.

He moved closer and placed his palm on the tree’s trunk. It pulsed beneath his skin, its surface warmer than he expected. There was a quiet, humming song to it—not in sound, but in feeling. As if it recognized the hands of an Early Creature and welcomed him.
He turned, eyes narrowing on the other two trees rising in the mist.

The second tree was strikingly different. Its bark was silvery black, not reflective but dense, like starlit obsidian pressed into shape. Long needles hung from its branches instead of leaves, and each one shimmered faintly with molten streaks of red and blue, like veins of early magma woven with spirit.
As he neared, another prompt danced into view.

|You have discovered the Ironroot Vulcan Tree of this Budding Shore. Once every cycle, it sheds Ironpetal Shell Fragments- materials imbued with Early Existential Weight that can be forged into Early Armor and Weapons. The resulting creations are permanently inscribed with a resonance of your True Source, gaining unique properties based on its Alignment and Resistance. The shedding cycle accelerates drastically with proper watering of Early Sacred Water.|

Noah shook his head as he reached out and caught one of the falling fragments- a petal shaped shard of dark silver etched with living runes that shimmered faintly in his hand. It was light, impossibly so, and yet he could feel its authority pressing down through his palm. His fingers trembled slightly under its weight.
His fingers...trembled under it weight as just who hell was he for a falling fragment to cause his finger to tremble?!
He could create something terrifying with the products of this tree!
And then he turned to the final tree.

This one was the smallest of the three, though still monumental by mortal standards. Its bark was smooth and pearlescent, almost translucent. Strange blooms formed at the joints of its branches- fleshy orbs of glowing pastel blues and pinks that pulsed faintly with slow breaths.

|You have discovered the Breathbloom Whisper Tree of this Budding Shore. It bears Whisperpods- early fruits that when consumed will bloom a single Existential Insight within the eater, a flash of understanding capable of granting the comprehension of a Lost Forgotten Principle. Their effect is unpredictable, but exponentially powerful. As with the other Trees, the ripening process is accelerated through the nourishment of Early Sacred Water.|
HUUM!
Lost...Forgotten Principles!
Noah closed his eyes.
Sunpetal Wheels. Whisperpods. Ironpetal Fragments.
Each of these alone would be beyond comprehension in any other domain of Existence.
And here they were... just waiting.
Each one filled with boundless possibilities of what could be.
He exhaled slowly, his hands resting at his sides.
"Everything in this place responds only to effort," he said quietly. "Nothing can be taken with ease as one truly has to move and live like an early primitive being..."
WAA!
Ruination and the Infiniverse had bright eyes as they looked around to see what other wonders there could be.
As if in answer, a new pulse of light shimmered in front of Noah, this time not from the trees, but from the ground itself. The air shifted. The sand trembled just so.
|You have interacted with a sufficient amount of the Budding Shore’s weavings. A Record of Early Creatures begins to reveal itself to you...|
|You have gained access to an Alternate Method of Progression unique to Early Creatures. A primitive, primal method born before structured systems existed.|
|Method: Inscription of Early Living Runes.|

|Each Rune requires the compression of 1,000,000 CQ and PQ into a single Early Living Existential Glyph. These Glyphs are branded upon Existence permanently, never requiring expenditure of energy. Movement, breath, and action become the medium through which Authority is expressed. No commands. No power expenditure. Only Existence. Early Creatures lived with such simplicity.|

|Each Early Living Existential Glyph grants the bearer a fundamental trait or power that activates through mere will and action. The compression and creation of a single Rune is monumentally difficult. |
HUUM!

chapters.title: Chapter 3861: Early Veiled Shore IV
paragraphs: His mind buzzed with wonder and possibilities as a unique methodology appeared!
The Inscription of Early Living Runes that actually took one’s immense complexity and Purity into Early Living Existential Glyph that they branded into their bodies!

It was terrifying to inagine as normal entities that attained Originus Venerant would have to simply continue building their Tower of Origin, making it more complex while budding branching towers alongside it...until the stage of Originus Venerant was completed.
But the Early Creatures did something else entirely!
Noah stared at the shimmering text, his fingers curling slightly.
Power that flows with motion. Power without cost.
No circuits. No channels. No activation required.
Just... being.
He had infinite mana as the cost of energy was never an issue, but this...this was something else!
And if he had the capability...
If his current Lattices and Resistances, if the depth of his Origins allowed it...
Was he not capable of inscribing multiple Existential Glyphs from multiple True Sources on his body?
BZZT!
The thought alone was terrifying.
His gaze slowly lifted, drifting over the calm sea, the fog-draped trees, the golden leaves, and the ever-present mist.
A place that could birth such possibilities...
What would happen if it were brought to maturity?
If the Budding Shore became... a complete Veiled Shore?
Noah didn’t know yet.
But he would find out.
With Ruination.
With the Infiniverse.
And with the terrifying weavings now blooming beneath his skin!
The path forward was clear.
He just had to step into it.
As Noah stood with his palm pressed lightly against the trunk of the Heartwood Suntree, his mind drifted freely toward the deeper knowledge the Early Veiled Shore had revealed.
The concept of Early Living Existential Glyphs seemed fundamental.
And with his current level of complexity and purity, he could form two.!
He knew it.

His instincts whispered it with confidence as his gaze flickered over his own body, his weavings alive with the glow of millions of Lattices and dozens of completed Towers of Origin. He was poised to compress the first Rune, a task that would take 1,000,000 CQ and PQ into a single mark of power. Permanent. Glorious. It was unlike anything he’d ever done before!
But as he proceeded to sit upon the earth, legs crossed and energy quietly gathering, a flickering shimmer interrupted his thoughts.
|The Early Veiled Shore has welcomed another entrant.|
|An Early Living Marine Lifeform has appeared within the Early Sacred Waters.|
|Population of the Early Veiled Shore: 4 / 25.|
HUUM!
He opened his eyes slowly.
Surprise rippled through him as it was not necessarily at the Marine Lifeform’s appearance, but at the revelation that the population of this consecrated domain could rise independently of his will!
Not everything here was under his control.

His jaw set in quiet thought as he stood, dusting off the faint glimmer of sunlight that clung to his robes. His feet carried him across the verdant grass and toward the shore, each step slow and deliberate as Ruination and the Infiniverse Body followed behind.
The Sacred Waters glistened like polished glass, light spilling over its surface in golden ribbons.
And there, he saw it.
Swimming just beneath the surface, its long, sweeping fins dragging luminescent trails behind it like brushstrokes on existence...it was beautiful.
A goldfish.
Massive and elegant. Its body gleamed with golden and cerulean scales, each one alive with movement. It hovered in the water with regal confidence, like it belonged here more than anything else.
Its expression was one of returning to a place that felt light as it breathed the Early Sacred Water freely!
As his gaze fell on it, new prompts bloomed.
|Name: Auriamundus, the Crownscale Glimmer.|
|Type: Early Living Marine Lifeform.|
|Authority Type: Living Water.|
|Early Living Existential Glyph: Water (1 Compressed Rune).|
|Tower of Origin: Living Water Tower of Origin.|
Noah blinked.
The creature, Auriamundus, had condensed a Glyph!
A Goldfish!
The goldfish was stronger than many entities he had come across in the Nullvein Gravewake Folds.
His lips curved into a tight smile.
"No authority to alter the sacred waters themselves..." he muttered, rolling his shoulders slowly, letting the hum of power simmer across his skin. "So. We go fishing. Like Early Creatures did."
HUUM!
He stepped forward, the water of the Shore folding against his ankles like syrup.
Then his knees.
Then his waist.

The moment his body entered past his ribs, the resistance was near suffocating. It was like walking through a sea of stone wrapped in honey- dense, unmoving, and pulling at every limb. The Sacred Waters were not meant to be traversed easily!
He called forth 10 Million Existential Dimensional Lattices as the moment they swirled and shone over his skin, the waters became easier to move around in!
As he did so.
The goldfish turned to him.
Its eyes were intelligent. Viciously so. Gold and blue irises narrowed as it caught sight of him. The single shining Glyph upon its head shimmered with warning, like a glowing crest.
Noah moved forward.
His foot sank into the water with slight resistance. His muscles strained against it as he was able to move freerer.
The goldfish didn’t flee.
It charged as the Glyph on its head shone brilliantly!
WU! WU! WU!
The streak of gold and blue was all he saw before it slammed into his abdomen with the force of a collapsing moon.
BOOM!
His body became a comet of light and water, blasted from the shallows and skidding across the grasslands like a discarded relic!

His upper robe of authority was shredded in an instant, fabric turning to light. His skin- surrounded by over 10 million activated Existential Dimensional Lattices- shone without blemish, unmarred by the force as he had no injuries!
But...
But!
He lay there for a second, blinking at the sky.
Then he sat up slowly.
His fingers dragged through his wet hair, water running down his face.
His gaze shifted toward the shoreline.
The goldfish floated there.
It flipped once.
Snorted.
And blew a stream of water into the air in lazy arrogance as it even taunted him!
Ruination appeared beside him, her expression uncharacteristically blank, but her crimson-gold hair flaring gently.
"Master," she said slowly, "shall we crush it together?"

The Infiniverse Body stood on the other side, her radiant form burning with vibrant hues, eyes locked on the creature with a glint that was far from forgiving. She had already computed 1 million different recipes on how a goldfish could be cooked!
Noah stood up, water trailing from his magisterial frame.

His upper body shimmered with bare skin layered in gleaming Lattices, forming ancient geometric patterns across his arms and chest. His form radiated unyielding grace, every motion surrounded by tangible force.
He raised a hand to the two of them and smiled.
"It’s a goldfish."
They said nothing.
"If I can’t beat a single goldfish in a place made by the steps of Early Creatures..."
He shook his head, chuckling lowly, the sound deep and filled with the thrill of challenge.
"You two analyze it. Focus on the Glyph."
Ruination nodded as she took several steps back.
Infiniverse raised a hand, threads of light forming translucent Towers of Origin in midair.
And Noah turned once more to the shore.
He was smiling.

His body flared with a burst of golden fire, and this time- this time, 50 million Lattices activated at once. They coiled across his limbs and spine. They whispered through his veins and bones. His movements were smooth, precise, unburdened by the weight of existence.
He stepped into the water.
It resisted him.
And then it gave way.
He slid, flowing through it with the grace of a blade sliding through silk.
The goldfish turned again.
Its Glyph shimmered once more!
And a terrifying war...was back on!

No circuits.
No channels.
No activation required.
Just... being.
He had infinite mana as the cost of energy was never an issue, but this...this was something else!
And if he had the capability...
If his current Lattices and Resistances, if the depth of his Origins allowed it...
Was he not capable of inscribing multiple Existential Glyphs from multiple True Sources on his body?
BZZT!
The thought alone was terrifying.
His gaze slowly lifted, drifting over the calm sea, the fog-draped trees, the golden leaves, and the ever-present mist.
A place that could birth such possibilities...
What would happen if it were brought to maturity?
If the Budding Shore became... a complete Veiled Shore?
Noah didn’t know yet.
But he would find out.
With Ruination.
With the Infiniverse.
And with the terrifying weavings now blooming beneath his skin!
The path forward was clear.
He just had to step into it.
As Noah stood with his palm pressed lightly against the trunk of the Heartwood Suntree, his mind drifted freely toward the deeper knowledge the Early Veiled Shore had revealed.
The concept of Early Living Existential Glyphs seemed fundamental.
And with his current level of complexity and purity, he could form two.!
He knew it.
His instincts whispered it with confidence as his gaze flickered over his own body, his weavings alive with the glow of millions of Lattices and dozens of completed Towers of Origin.
He was poised to compress the first Rune, a task that would take 1,000,000 CQ and PQ into a single mark of power.
Permanent.
Glorious.
It was unlike anything he’d ever done before!
But as he proceeded to sit upon the earth, legs crossed and energy quietly gathering, a flickering shimmer interrupted his thoughts.
|The Early Veiled Shore has welcomed another entrant.|
|An Early Living Marine Lifeform has appeared within the Early Sacred Waters.|
|Population of the Early Veiled Shore: 4 / 25.|
HUUM!
He opened his eyes slowly.
Surprise rippled through him as it was not necessarily at the Marine Lifeform’s appearance, but at the revelation that the population of this consecrated domain could rise independently of his will!
Not everything here was under his control.
His jaw set in quiet thought as he stood, dusting off the faint glimmer of sunlight that clung to his robes.
His feet carried him across the verdant grass and toward the shore, each step slow and deliberate as Ruination and the Infiniverse Body followed behind.
The Sacred Waters glistened like polished glass, light spilling over its surface in golden ribbons.
And there, he saw it.
Swimming just beneath the surface, its long, sweeping fins dragging luminescent trails behind it like brushstrokes on existence...it was beautiful.
A goldfish.
Massive and elegant.
Its body gleamed with golden and cerulean scales, each one alive with movement.
It hovered in the water with regal confidence, like it belonged here more than anything else.
Its expression was one of returning to a place that felt light as it breathed the Early Sacred Water freely!
As his gaze fell on it, new prompts bloomed.
|Name: Auriamundus, the Crownscale Glimmer.|
|Type: Early Living Marine Lifeform.|
|Authority Type: Living Water.|
|Early Living Existential Glyph: Water (1 Compressed Rune).|
|Tower of Origin: Living Water Tower of Origin.|
Noah blinked.
The creature, Auriamundus, had condensed a Glyph!
A Goldfish!
The goldfish was stronger than many entities he had come across in the Nullvein Gravewake Folds.
His lips curved into a tight smile.
"No authority to alter the sacred waters themselves..." he muttered, rolling his shoulders slowly, letting the hum of power simmer across his skin.
"So.
We go fishing.
Like Early Creatures did."
HUUM!
He stepped forward, the water of the Shore folding against his ankles like syrup.
Then his knees.
Then his waist.
The moment his body entered past his ribs, the resistance was near suffocating.
It was like walking through a sea of stone wrapped in honey- dense, unmoving, and pulling at every limb.
The Sacred Waters were not meant to be traversed easily!
He called forth 10 Million Existential Dimensional Lattices as the moment they swirled and shone over his skin, the waters became easier to move around in!
As he did so.
The goldfish turned to him.
Its eyes were intelligent.
Viciously so.
Gold and blue irises narrowed as it caught sight of him.
The single shining Glyph upon its head shimmered with warning, like a glowing crest.
Noah moved forward.
His foot sank into the water with slight resistance.
His muscles strained against it as he was able to move freerer.
The goldfish didn’t flee.
It charged as the Glyph on its head shone brilliantly!
WU!
WU!
WU!
The streak of gold and blue was all he saw before it slammed into his abdomen with the force of a collapsing moon.
BOOM!
His body became a comet of light and water, blasted from the shallows and skidding across the grasslands like a discarded relic!
His upper robe of authority was shredded in an instant, fabric turning to light.
His skin- surrounded by over 10 million activated Existential Dimensional Lattices- shone without blemish, unmarred by the force as he had no injuries!
But...
But!
He lay there for a second, blinking at the sky.
Then he sat up slowly.
His fingers dragged through his wet hair, water running down his face.
His gaze shifted toward the shoreline.
The goldfish floated there.
It flipped once.
Snorted.
And blew a stream of water into the air in lazy arrogance as it even taunted him!
Ruination appeared beside him, her expression uncharacteristically blank, but her crimson-gold hair flaring gently.
"Master," she said slowly, "shall we crush it together?"
The Infiniverse Body stood on the other side, her radiant form burning with vibrant hues, eyes locked on the creature with a glint that was far from forgiving.
She had already computed 1 million different recipes on how a goldfish could be cooked!
Noah stood up, water trailing from his magisterial frame.
His upper body shimmered with bare skin layered in gleaming Lattices, forming ancient geometric patterns across his arms and chest.
His form radiated unyielding grace, every motion surrounded by tangible force.
He raised a hand to the two of them and smiled.
"It’s a goldfish."
They said nothing.
"If I can’t beat a single goldfish in a place made by the steps of Early Creatures..."
He shook his head, chuckling lowly, the sound deep and filled with the thrill of challenge.
"You two analyze it.
Focus on the Glyph."
Ruination nodded as she took several steps back.
Infiniverse raised a hand, threads of light forming translucent Towers of Origin in midair.
And Noah turned once more to the shore.
He was smiling.
His body flared with a burst of golden fire, and this time- this time, 50 million Lattices activated at once.
They coiled across his limbs and spine.
They whispered through his veins and bones.
His movements were smooth, precise, unburdened by the weight of existence.
He stepped into the water.
It resisted him.
And then it gave way.
He slid, flowing through it with the grace of a blade sliding through silk.
The goldfish turned again.
Its Glyph shimmered once more!
And a terrifying war...was back on!

chapters.title: Chapter 3862: Early Veiled Shore V
paragraphs: Noah plunged into the Early Sacred Waters with purpose, his body carving into the calm surface and shattering it into radiant ripples.
A blinding hum echoed outward as the surface of his skin bloomed with cascading golden sigils- fifty million Existential Dimensional Lattices shimmering like suns dragged into form.
The weight of this place demanded stillness.
But Noah had never been one to simply endure!
HUUM!

The waters pushed back, thick and resisting, yet his steps stirred it like thunder rolling beneath the sea. The moment his foot landed on unseen currents, his body adjusted to the weight, gliding forward, pulsing with existence in a way only a Living Existence could.
The Early Living Marine Lifeform, Auriamundus, was waiting as it roared!

It moved like a concept. Like the memory of motion given form. The gold-blue beast turned within the water’s waves, eyes too ancient for their delicate shape. Its fins danced like tongues of blue flame, and the glyph upon its forehead...oh, the glyph!
It glowed as though it had always been lit, as though it had never known a time when it wasn’t etched into existence!
The Glyph of Water.
Primitive. Pure.
The moment their eyes met, the waters churned.
Auriamundus launched forward.

Noah braced as the goldfish slammed into him again with the sheer rawness of being. The Glyph on its head flared and the waters bent around it, thickening like walls as it swam in a spiraling arc, impossibly fast. It struck like a collapsing tide, and Noah felt his bones creak from the reverberation of motion soaked in 1,000,000 units of Pure Complexity and Purity.
Even his current 50 Million displayed Lattices didn’t nullify that entirely.
The Glyph didn’t ask for mana.
It didn’t need cost.
It was.
That was what made it dangerous.
Every movement the Crownscale made came with meaning. A swipe of the tail carried blades of ancient water, scything across the waves with howling precision.
Each attack carrying condensed attacks that were in excess of 1 Million PQ and CQ!
And because the Glyph did not require mana kr authority...it could continue releasing and spamming these attacks endlessly!
Such a thing...reminded him of what he always loved to do with his Infinity Mana.
An Existential Glyph...allowed one to have a semblance of this capability!
BOOM!

The heavy attacks struck him with no pause, one after the other. Primitive arcs of condensed Living Water smashed against his chest, his arms, his neck. They cracked against the armorless brilliance of his skin, each one echoing like war drums against the walls of a primal temple.

He swam, twisting through them, slipping under the gouging force of hydromantic bursts. One spiral of his shoulder, and he rolled through a current infused with the Water Glyph’s pulsing barrier- one that sizzled when he brushed it, even with fifty million Lattices flaring.
He felt the Glyph more than he saw it.
Felt the density of the authority. The purity.
It was everywhere!
And for every brilliant strike Noah dodged, another followed. Another tailwhip. Another spiral of condensed seafoam bursting with Living Authority.
For a moment, Noah smiled underwater.
His body felt like a brand new item just now being put to use after his elevation!
His eyes were alight with something primal.
"This is what it means to just exist!"
HUUM
He whispered into the currents, his voice lost but felt in the vibration of his being.
The Glyph burned again, slamming another wave into him.
He flipped backward, catching himself in the curl of the misty tides, floating above the goldfish as he appraised it once more.
Auriamundus glared, puffing out a burst of bubbles that shimmered with the glow of a storm. Its arrogance radiated through the sacred silence of the waters.
And Noah nodded once, his hand trailing backward.
"Alright," he said quietly. "I’ve had enough fun."
The air shifted.
The waters shifted.
His Lattices... surged.

One by one, their golden silhouettes multiplied. The resonance of his body deepened. Fifty million? They exploded past that, cascading like a tidal starfire. Seventy million. One hundred. One hundred and twenty-five million!
Reality bent around his skin.
Towers of Origin, dozens of them, appeared like mirages orbiting him.
Of the Singed. Of Infinity. Of Origin. Of Paradox! They shimmered behind him, towering above the currents as if even the sacred waters could not deny them.
The Crownscale froze.
A single glimmer of panic crept into its fluid eyes.
And Noah moved.

He didn’t call down the heavens. He didn’t fire spells. He didn’t call forth cataclysms. His hands- his bare, forged, quintessential hands- cut through the water like spears born in the dawn of ancient time. They cleaved through the glowing blue barrier of the Glyph that protected the goldfish.
The sacred water parted.
The glyph flared.
And then, Noah grabbed.

His fingers closed around the sides of the Crownscale’s shimmering head, slipping past the barrier, slipping past the scales and straight through the gills. With his other hand, he pressed against the side of the glyph, and let over two million of his own condensed Complexity and Purity erupt outward.
BOOM!
A heavy, undeniable impact.
The glyph flickered as the barrier it had shattered!
Then it dimmed.
A breath passed between them.
And the water stilled.
Auriamundus stopped moving as his hands, akin to spears, pieced into its body with a lighf of ending...Everything.

Its body gleamed dimly in the sacred light, and Noah gently pulled it toward him, his expression unreadable. He placed the weight of it on his shoulder, the finned tail hanging behind him like a silken banner.
The Crownscale was warm.
Still glowing.
Still pulsing.
But its Beginning... had ended.
Noah stepped out of the water.
His upper body was laid bare, droplets of sacred mist trailing down his skin, dripping from the sharp edge of his jaw, from the carved lines of his chest and shoulders.
His muscles, adorned in glimmering etchings of Lattices, caught the light of the sacred shore with a terrifying beauty.
He carried the goldfish like a prize. Like a symbol.
And in the haze of radiant existence, with mist curling like reverence around his ankles, he looked every inch the Early Creature this land had asked for!
Noah Osmont, an Early Creature!

chapters.title: Chapter 3863: Early Veiled Shore VI
paragraphs: The scent of mist still clung to his skin as Noah stepped from the sea, the body of Auriamundus slung over one shoulder like a quintessential treasure.
Its scales shimmered with threads of gold and blue, catching the dim light of the Early Veiled Shore and scattering it across the sand in ripples of brilliance.
Each step he took pressed lightly into the untouched soil, the sacred granules humming beneath his feet as though acknowledging the return of an Early Creature.
He lowered the Crownscale Glimmer gently onto the ground.
Ruination and the Infiniverse Body flanked him without a word, drawn by the stillness and the quiet reverence that clung to the corpse like a final hymn.
A soft chime echoed as he looked at the Early Living Marine Lifeform.

|You have slain and acquired the body of Auriamundus, the Crownscale Glimmer. A nutrient-rich Early Living Marine Lifeform. Its flesh will proliferate Complexity and Purity within the Originus Venerant stage. It has flesh that explodes with weaving potential, cutting the forging cost of Living Towers of Origin and Early Living Existential Glyphs by half. As Early Creatures developed, they gathered together while sharing flesh of Early Living Marine Lifeforms in rituals of complexity and purity.|
Noah’s eyes gleamed. Even before the next prompt arrived, he had already known to expect it.
|Boiling the Crownscale Glimmer in Early Sacred Waters will more than double its effects.|
He turned slowly, his gaze drifting across the vast untouched beauty of the Early Veiled Shore.
Everything here was deliberate. Timeless. Untouched by the conveniences of authority.
The Sacred Waters had rejected command. The glyph-bearing goldfish had demanded hand-to-hand defiance. It meant that creation here had to be earned.
And in this place, that was the most sacred thing of all.

Everything fit and had purpose, so if a prompt said that marine life forms could be boiled by sacred water, which was resistant to authority, then it meant there was a means to do it as the only feasible way was through something that stemmed from these very same veiled shores.
Noah looked around.
At the trees and waters. At the sand.
The...sand?
He gazed down.
His fingers dug lightly into the sand at his feet. It was pale ivory, its warmth delicate but ancient- each grain humming with strange potential.
|The Sand of the Early Veiled Shore. Unique in nature, but malleable for a myriad of uses.|
He smiled and thought about how he could utilize this to make a tool for the purpose of boiling the Early Living Marine Lifeform. And an answer was...
"Glassification," he muttered.
WAA!
The Infiniverse tilted her head with quiet curiosity, and Noah motioned her over. "Come. Let’s shape the first tool of this place."
The Infiniverse Body nodded silently as radiance burst from her.

Multicolored flames burst from their joined palms, each lick of fire fueled by Living Existential Authority. It melted the sand into thick molten threads, glowing like starlit syrup, and then cooled it slowly with precise infusions of compressed Continuity.
They shaped it with careful strokes, drawing from memory and instinct until something beautiful was gradually born.
It did not take too long!
The shore trembled.
|You have created the first artifact of the Early Veiled Shore.|
|Item Name: Wok of the Primordial Bloom.|

|Description: A vessel born from Sacred Sand and shaped by Living Existential Authority. When subjected to heat, it emits Early Sacred Flames capable of cooking any entity originating from the Early Veiled Shore.|
It was nearly twice Noah’s size, its wide crystalline belly glinting beneath the veil of sacred light, the curved edges swirling with faint sigils of purity.
He nodded once, satisfied.

The Infiniverse carried the glowing wok to the Sacred Waters and, with gentle reverence, filled it with a scoop of that pristine liquid. She returned to where Noah had already called forth the miniature form of his Singed Tower of Origin- its flaming Mythic Signatures rising like effigies of his silhouette, golden robes billowing, holding the tower aloft.
When she placed the wok on its crown- on the top of this Singed Tower of Origin, it accepted the heat like an offering to a sleeping titan!
HUUM!
The waters inside shimmered. Flames curled beneath the surface like embryonic stars. A bloom of aurora spread across the surface of the wok, washing the sands in glistening color.
Noah exhaled, deeply.

He turned then, just in time to see Ruination kneeling beside the fallen Auriamundus, her hands pressing down gently against the creature’s scaled head. Her eyes blazed, her face soft with purpose. Crimson gold brilliance erupted from her palms, flowing into the corpse like threads of celestial silk.
|The Living Origin, Ruination, has made a Declaration of Living Existential Proliferation targeting the corpse of the Early Living Marine Lifeform.|
The light twisted, condensed, and... split.
When it faded, two new bodies lay beside the original, each the same size, slightly different. Their glyphs pulsed quietly beneath scaled skin.
Noah approached, placing a hand atop her head as her eyes closed with contentment.
"Well done."
She smiled faintly, her pride silent but tangible.

With glory, he lifted the original Crownscale and placed it into the Wok of the Primordial Bloom. The moment its flesh touched the warming Sacred Waters, a sound like soft bells rang out like chimes of a forgotten age.
From the bubbling surface of the wok rose the most intoxicating aroma he had ever known.

It was sweet, yet deep. Rich, yet light. It shimmered with notes of purity, of complexity- like essence itself had been distilled and folded into steam. The scent swirled with Living Origin Authority, wrapping around them all like a blanket of early memory.
Ruination and the Infiniverse moved closer, their expressions growing solemn.
Noah sat, legs folded, bare chest still glinting with drying sacred droplets. The firelight danced along the lines of his body, casting his form in a warlike serenity.
He asked.
"Have you both studied the glyph formation method?"
They nodded in unison.
"Then let’s begin. If we get stuck..." He gestured toward the steaming wok, his smile edged with silent wonder. "...we’ll have a little help here soon."
He closed his eyes.
The world narrowed to the rhythm of his breathing.
The Methodology to form an Early Living Existential Glyph!
Each one requiring 1 Million PQ and CQ!

Inside him, his Lattices shimmered like stars caught in a net. His Complexity and Purity rose, coiling, converging. He summoned it all toward a single point above his brow, and there, a singularity began to bloom.
A seed of something old. Something lost.
In the background, the Early Sacred Flames continued to burn, and the scent of divine nourishment deepened.

Sitting in the midst of it, Noah could not help but feel a sense of fulfillment and happiness, as if a level of peace he always sought...was being achieved in a way be did not expect in this Early Veiled Shore!
As wonders bloomed in the center of a Wheel of Existence.
In another corner of the Nullvein Gravewake Folds, in a certain Prison.

Thauron was returning towards the wriggling Inevitability that he had left to devour prisoners, his expression that of many complex possibilities as he had received shocking boons for his information about Ozymandias!
Now, if they also knew of his identity as Noah Osmont...if they knew this other part of him was likely in these very same folds and not protected by Living Paradoxes...
But he would not give them everything. Well, maybe not now!
He smiled gleefully as he went forward.
In the distance, the wriggling Inevitability...was silent.
Still.
In the depths of its being, calm and silent eyes were watching the coming Thauron as he had no idea.
Eyes that at this moment...had a Living Seed blooming as they fed from an Inevitability- allowing for impossible things to occur as a silent aura of Living was blooming!
An aura of Purpose and Beginning as at this moment, it would strike to change everything!

When she placed the wok on its crown- on the top of this Singed Tower of Origin, it accepted the heat like an offering to a sleeping titan!
HUUM!
The waters inside shimmered.
Flames curled beneath the surface like embryonic stars.
A bloom of aurora spread across the surface of the wok, washing the sands in glistening color.
Noah exhaled, deeply.
He turned then, just in time to see Ruination kneeling beside the fallen Auriamundus, her hands pressing down gently against the creature’s scaled head.
Her eyes blazed, her face soft with purpose.
Crimson gold brilliance erupted from her palms, flowing into the corpse like threads of celestial silk.
|The Living Origin, Ruination, has made a Declaration of Living Existential Proliferation targeting the corpse of the Early Living Marine Lifeform.|
The light twisted, condensed, and... split.
When it faded, two new bodies lay beside the original, each the same size, slightly different.
Their glyphs pulsed quietly beneath scaled skin.
Noah approached, placing a hand atop her head as her eyes closed with contentment.
"Well done."
She smiled faintly, her pride silent but tangible.
With glory, he lifted the original Crownscale and placed it into the Wok of the Primordial Bloom.
The moment its flesh touched the warming Sacred Waters, a sound like soft bells rang out like chimes of a forgotten age.
From the bubbling surface of the wok rose the most intoxicating aroma he had ever known.
It was sweet, yet deep.
Rich, yet light.
It shimmered with notes of purity, of complexity- like essence itself had been distilled and folded into steam.
The scent swirled with Living Origin Authority, wrapping around them all like a blanket of early memory.
Ruination and the Infiniverse moved closer, their expressions growing solemn.
Noah sat, legs folded, bare chest still glinting with drying sacred droplets.
The firelight danced along the lines of his body, casting his form in a warlike serenity.
He asked.
"Have you both studied the glyph formation method?"
They nodded in unison.
"Then let’s begin.
If we get stuck..." He gestured toward the steaming wok, his smile edged with silent wonder.
"...we’ll have a little help here soon."
He closed his eyes.
The world narrowed to the rhythm of his breathing.
The Methodology to form an Early Living Existential Glyph!
Each one requiring 1 Million PQ and CQ!
Inside him, his Lattices shimmered like stars caught in a net.
His Complexity and Purity rose, coiling, converging.
He summoned it all toward a single point above his brow, and there, a singularity began to bloom.
A seed of something old.
Something lost.
In the background, the Early Sacred Flames continued to burn, and the scent of divine nourishment deepened.

Sitting in the midst of it, Noah could not help but feel a sense of fulfillment and happiness, as if a level of peace he always sought...was being achieved in a way be did not expect in this Early Veiled Shore!
As wonders bloomed in the center of a Wheel of Existence.
In another corner of the Nullvein Gravewake Folds, in a certain Prison.

Thauron was returning towards the wriggling Inevitability that he had left to devour prisoners, his expression that of many complex possibilities as he had received shocking boons for his information about Ozymandias!
Now, if they also knew of his identity as Noah Osmont...if they knew this other part of him was likely in these very same folds and not protected by Living Paradoxes...
But he would not give them everything.
Well, maybe not now!
He smiled gleefully as he went forward.
In the distance, the wriggling Inevitability...was silent.
Still.
In the depths of its being, calm and silent eyes were watching the coming Thauron as he had no idea.
Eyes that at this moment...had a Living Seed blooming as they fed from an Inevitability- allowing for impossible things to occur as a silent aura of Living was blooming!
An aura of Purpose and Beginning as at this moment, it would strike to change everything!

chapters.title: Chapter 3864: Glyph! I
paragraphs: In the Paradoxical Prison, the silence was always a horror.

The coffins had been torn wide open, their bindings unraveled, and the entities once trapped within were nothing more than vapor and digesting resonance. Mighty beings, some marked by the gleam of Primarchy, others holding the flickering grandeur of Originus Venerant distinction- all gone. Consumed!
What remained of them pulsed like distant echoes clinging to the moist walls, and at the center of the room, it writhed.
The Inevitability.
A mass of ever-churning tentacles, multicolored and immense, pulsing with the vibrant horror of finality.

It shifted with slow hunger, each limb glowing in impossible hues, feeding upon the residue of power it had been given- scraps of titanic existences torn from their chains and devoured as if they were nothing more than broth.
Through the broken arch of the Prison’s gateway, Thauron entered.
His eyes sparkled with wild delight, dark robes tattered and dusted with particles of golden matter. He floated lazily forward, his mouth stretching into a smile as he approached the wriggling mass.
"Miss me?" he asked, voice light, almost fond. He extended a hand toward the throbbing surface of the Inevitability, fingers glowing with a faint obsidian light of Finality.
But...
The reaction was immediate.
BOOM!

A light blazed from the Inevitability, pure and monstrous, and in the next instant, thousands of tentacles erupted. They wrapped around Thauron like lovers lost in longing, like a creature reclaiming its own.
His expression turned to stone, but his lips still moved in cool brilliance!
From within the mass came a voice. Low. Steady.
"Yes," it said, "It has missed you greatly."
The words were soaked in layered meaning. Each syllable crawled like worms over flesh.
"So much so," the voice continued, "that from now on, you will never be separated again."
HUUM!
Thauron stilled.
Then, slowly, he turned his head and narrowed his eyes. "...Little Bobby?"
At the center of the Inevitability, something began to rise. A silhouette formed in the heart of the tentacles, light and shadow coalescing.
A figure emerged, stepping out of the wriggling heart.
Bob.
Bob!

His form now shimmered in stellar obsidian. A celestial presence cloaked in restrained sorrow. Behind him, wings of shadow and starlight unfolded- four pairs, black and white, stretching with the dignity of glory. Halos hovered, dense and quiet, orbiting his head like ancient judgments.
"You shouldn’t be aware," Thauron muttered with a sense of confusion."You shouldn’t be this."
Bob’s voice was soft, yet it carried like a glorious hymn. "You’re right. I shouldn’t."
He turned, fully revealing himself as the one who had forced the exchange- switching places with Thauron, who now found himself being pulled deeper into the core of the Inevitability.
"But I discovered something."
He paused, eyes simmering with weary wrath.
"Inevitabilities crave Living Existential Authority more than anything else."
Thauron’s face twitched. For the first time, true surprise glimmered there.

"That’s impossible," he said flatly, sharply. "You had no pathway, no weavings left. There’s no way you could have attained any possible authority, much less Living Existential Authority! That approaches Foldless Ones! You cannot just have randomly gained a power I have been chasing long before you were born!"
WAA!
A sense lividity now burned in Thauron!
Bob stood calmly. "I didn’t obtain. Not the normal way."
He turned his gaze back toward the Inevitability, its tentacles now tightening around the writhing Thauron, the mass quivering with delight.
"You used to speak about little fish and big fish, Thauron."
His voice cut sharper now.
"But there was one fish you and I both misunderstood. One that didn’t belong in your web of definitions. One that paced the path freely... and left something behind."
Thauron opened his mouth, but the words were swallowed by the rising sound of the Inevitability’s hunger, its roar vibrating through the walls of the prison.
"You don’t know," Bob whispered with venom, "how many sleepless moments I spent looking for a way. For her. For my Liora."
His feet moved with purpose, passing the writhing cocoon of the Inevitability, his steps echoing on cracked stone.
At the far end of the Inevitability, resting within ruins, it lay.
A Wheel.
Obsidian. Massive. Faint and flickering.
A Dead Wheel of Existence.

Bob approached it with reverent silence, kneeling slowly before its immense bulk. His fingers, glowing faintly now, traced the invisible lines etched across the Wheel’s dark surface. Every ridge was familiar. Every fracture carved into his soul.
He stared into its center- into the void where a soul once danced.
Liora.
His light.
Broken. Gone. Dead!
And yet, he could feel her now.
He had kept the Wheel hidden. Even as the Inevitability devoured all else, he had preserved this. And now, he had what he needed.
His hands rose.
Living Origin Authority pulsed out.
It radiated with warm desperation and boundless power, flowing into the Wheel’s dormant core. A golden hue surged where the black had once ruled. Within the stillness, something stirred.
The remnants of his daughter’s soul, for so long unreachable, flickered.
Her broken self trembled in the wake of the Authority washing over her. Bob didn’t dare breathe. He only let it pour out- his power, his love, his hope.
Living Existential Authority.
When it came to Dead Things, the only thing that could give them life...was that which was truly living!

He was always looking for a solution as he thought Noah Osmont would have the key to it. And while he was not led to the Loom or anything that terrifying, he was given Living Existential Authority through him.
Through his entanglement!
So at the end of the day, he truly did have the key!
A second passed.
Then another.
And slowly... softly... the soul began to shine.
Her Existence began to return!
Tiny sparks glimmered like stars behind clouds, and Bob saw her face forming, no longer a memory or a phantom. A budding spark of real presence, waking to the warmth of his Authority.
He let out a breath, knees hitting the floor.
Tears spilled from his eyes and streamed down the sides of his cheeks. His shoulders shook, and a laugh broke free, quiet and broken, but real.
"Finally," he whispered, his voice hoarse with reverence.
"Finally..."
He leaned his forehead against the edge of the Wheel, tears dripping onto its surface, evaporating in golden light.
"I can save you, little light."
His voice trembled again.
"I can save you, my daughter."
The Inevitability roared louder behind him, its tendrils tightening around Thauron in ecstasy, as if in exchange for the flood of power it now craved.
But Bob... Bob didn’t look back. His eyes never left the forming light at the heart of the Wheel.

chapters.title: Chapter 3865: Glyph! II
paragraphs: The Dead Wheel trembled.

Living Origin Authority streamed into its ancient spokes, flooding through fractured channels like a river reclaiming the veins of a long-dead creature. Bob knelt before it, his body bowed, his eyes unwavering. Each breath was heavy. Each heartbeat carried strain.
He was giving Living Origin Authority to what had known only death!
But the cost bled through him.

His Authority was vast, newly bloomed, still unfamiliar in its scope. But it wasn’t infinite. It burned hot, radiant with intent, but he could feel the edges fraying. It was not enough- not when what he aimed to awaken had slept for what felt like eons!
So he gave more.
HUUM!
More than Authority. More than essence.
He even gave some of the seed of himself- the bloom that had started it all, that singular beginning that marked him as something more than he had ever dreamed.
He gave it to her.
The Inevitability roared behind him.
A sound of wrath. A sound of hunger betrayed.
It knew.
The price Bob had promised... was slipping from its reach.

The mass of multicolored tentacles writhed violently, slamming into the walls around Bob as it sought what had been denied. But Bob stood firm, his ragged figure shining dimly, barely a silhouette before the towering Wheel.
Half of his weavings as a newly born Living Origin were gone.
He could feel it. As if his own soul had been torn in two, one part beating gently in his chest, the other pulsing within the obsidian wheel that now shook violently.
Then...
BOOM!
Existence trembled.
Light spilled out in an incandescent bloom, weaving through every fracture in the Wheel of Existence. The spokes screamed, then sang.
And from the center, she came.
Waves of light shimmered into form, and out stepped a figure with tan, caramel skin that glistened as if freshly forged. Her hair, dark and long, rippled with strands of starlight.
Three broken white gold halos floated solemnly above her head, and six torn wings, tattered and translucent, fluttered behind her.
Her eyes opened.
Bright. Piercing. White-gold like dawn breaking after endless night.
She looked at Bob, and in that instant, an ever present ache in her chest gave way to a flood of tears.
"Daddy...!"
The word fell like a whisper, then shattered the silence of the Paradoxical Prison as she rushed forward.
Bob caught her.
He staggered but stayed upright, wrapping his arms around her. His trembling hands buried into her hair as she clung to him tightly, her body light but real. Her presence undeniable.
A few times, his chest heaved up and down as he squeezed to confirm all of this was real!
It was real, right?!
His daughter. His light!
"I’m...here," he whispered hoarsely. "I’m sorry. I’m so sorry, my light. For being weak. For taking so long..."
Bob felt countless years of pain and death flash before him.
And her...
Her voice broke as she shook her head, her cheek pressed into his chest. "No. I saw it all. I heard everything. You never gave up. You... you did everything."

His fingers trembled over her back, clutching the pieces of her like a Father who feared she’d vanish again. The warmth of her soul settled against him, anchoring him for the first time in countless ages.
This was it. Everything.
Everything!
But the moment of stillness broke with a hiss.
BZZZT!
They pulled apart in instinct as Bob’s eyes snapped down. Writhing tendrils had slithered silently, nearly touching Liora’s frame and wrapping around her.
The Inevitability had found her.
Its hunger was absolute, its need insatiable. The strands curled hungrily toward the Living Origin power within her.
Bob snarled.
His foot slammed down and his hand flared with raw Authority as he pushed the tendrils back. "No! Not her."
The tentacles recoiled, then struck again, but he stood firm.
Bound. That was the deal.
He’d given his power to the Inevitability in exchange for its help. It wanted more now. It wanted what lived within her.
But how could he allow for that?
"I made this deal," Bob whispered bitterly. "And now, I pay it. To have you alive again, to have you Living is more than I could ask for..."
WAA!
Liora looked up at him, confusion and fear trembling in her golden eyes.
"You... you can’t mean to stay-"
"I’m already tainted," he said softly. "Bound to a poison I can’t let touch you. You’re pure now. You’re born again."
He looked into her eyes, memorizing every line of her face. "You can’t stay here. You must go."
Tears slipped down her cheeks again. "But... I just...I just came back..."
He smiled, a shadowed thing filled with pain and pride. Tired. Weary. But happy.
"And that’s why I can finally let go."
BZZT!

More tendrils snapped, and Bob’s hands glowed as he forced them back. His words came quickly now. "There’s someone. The one responsible for all this. The one who made this possible. He can control this madness... and he can protect you."
The Inevitability shrieked.
Bob’s knees buckled, but he did not fall.
"I will reach out to him. Find him, and he will find you!" he breathed. "When I gains control over this creature, I will know how to find you, and I will see you again!"
Liora hesitated.
"Go!" he shouted.
With unfathomable hesitation...
WAP!
She vanished in golden light.
And Bob turned, the last remnants of his strength surging forward, dragging the Inevitability’s focus entirely back onto him.
In the heart of the Early Veiled Shore, Noah knelt beneath the twilight mist of living existence.

Tens of millions of Lattices were surging through his body, their shapes folding and unfolding into intricate geometries above his brow. A storm of complexity spun slowly around his form, coalescing into a singularity upon his forehead.
His breathing was measured.
Fifty percent of all the Lattices he possessed- drawn from dozens of True Sources- were now burning toward a single purpose.
A Glyph.
A singular Early Living Existential Glyph.
And it was nearly impossible.
Others would have chosen simplicity. A Glyph of Flame. A Glyph of Wind. He had dozens of True Sources interwoven, many still wild, unaligned.
The swirling forces bucked and clashed. Some refused to bend, others resisted fusion entirely. The more he compressed, the more they threatened to unravel.
So he did the most natural thing in the world.
He raised his hand toward the Wok.
The sizzle of seared flesh welcomed him.
Primal.
Glorious.

He grabbed a chunk of the Crownscale Glimmer’s meat- golden and steaming-and bit into it with sharpened hunger. His teeth tore through it, and the moment it hit his tongue, a jolt of power surged down his spine.
It was clarity.
A flow of coherent, seamless energy began to surge across his forehead, the chaotic dance of Lattices settling under a single guiding pressure.
The Glyph of Water.
From the depths of the Crownscale Glimmer, from its condensed glyph... the understanding bloomed in him.
Water was not weakness.
Water held. Water moved. Water bound.
And now, it bound his madness.
The chaotic authorities of the Singed and Time, Paradox and Origin, all began to flow as a blue sheen surrounded the spiraling glyph above his brow.
The waters steadied the tides of his impossible complexity.
And the Glyph began to solidify!
